messages:
sasha: Hey team — intake for a new candidate I want to triage: open-70b-2026 (FP16 baseline) + q4f quant variant. Need quick prioritization and a minimal smoke checklist before we commit GPUs.
kevin: +1, can you paste the workloads we care about? latency-sensitive chat and long-context summarization.
maria: Also include embedding parity for semantic search — budget constraints matter.
sasha: Workloads: 1) low-latency chat (<=200ms p50 target on dedicated pool), 2) long-doc summarization (8k tokens), 3) semantic embeddings (use existing embedding suite).
olivia: Quick ask: what are our pass/fail heuristics for the quant run vs FP16?
sasha: Proposal: must meet these to pass smoke gate: 1) chat p50 < 2x FP16 baseline and p95 < 3x OR absolute p95 < 600ms; 2) end-task QA EM delta <= 2% vs baseline on our dev set; 3) embeddings cosine mean shift <= 0.015; 4) no high-severity hallucination regression in our checklist examples.
jason: Can we make those thresholds slightly looser for canary? Maybe EM delta <=3% for canary then tighten for full rollout.
maria: I agree — canary tolerances: EM <=3%, embeddings shift <=0.02. If canary passes, then run the full acceptance with original thresholds.
kevin: What should the smoke harness run include? small sample sizes but deterministic seeds. I suggest: 200 chat prompts, 100 long-docs, 500 embedding pairs.
sasha: Yep. Also run automatic unit checks: tokenization diff, kv-cache sanity, and prefix-cache correctness. Add quick perf checks: memory (OOMs), peak GPU utilization, and per-step latency histogram.
eval-bot: run 1767001111: started quant-smoke on cluster-dedicated-2. Config: q4f, batch=1, seq=2048, seeds=42. ETA ~30m.
eval-bot: run 1767001111: finished. Summary: chat p50=210ms (FP16 baseline 95ms), chat p95=540ms, QA EM delta=-1.8% (within canary), embeddings mean cosine shift=0.012, no OOMs, memory +15% vs FP16.
olivia: Thanks. So canary pass per canary thresholds. Next: schedule 6-hour canary with real traffic and monitor drift / errors.
sasha: Action items: 1) @kevin configure canary route + fallback policy; 2) @maria kick off 6h canary on dedicated pool; 3) @jason add two hallucination examples to regression set; 4) @olivia update dashboard panels for model variant.
kevin: Will do. I'll wire the fallback to FP16 and set automatic rollback on error rate >1% or latency SLO breach.
maria: Starting canary in ~15m. Will post final metrics.
jason: Added hallucination examples to eval harness: `tests/hallucination/edge_cases.json` — small note: need to update our error taxonomy mapping.
sasha: Nice. If canary is green, open a request for reserved capacity and schedule a full quant verification run (2k chat, 1k long-doc, 5k embeddings).
olivia: One more: add a quality tag in rollout notes: `quant-canary-q4f-1767001111` for tracing.
eval-bot: canary run 1767001111-canary: started.
eval-bot: canary run 1767001111-canary: interim: 2h—error rate 0.3%, latency within canary SLO.
kevin: Good signals. Leaving the rollback triggers as planned.
sasha: Thanks everyone — will follow up after canary completes. :thumbsup:
